title: Consent revoked during a call or while work is pending
description: The consent registry records a revocation (recording, transcription/AI processing or notification subscription) during the call or after work was accepted; recording, AI processing and notifications must stop for the revoked dimension.
callerVisible: The caller is told recording or automated processing has stopped and is offered a person.
backendEvidence: Consent state EXPIRED/DECLINED recorded with time
Recorder stopped and no further AI processing for the call
Pending notifications for the revoked subscription cancelled
notes: Added to the fixed fault registry for the follow-on prompt section 17 fault matrix. The LOCAL FIXTURE driver does not inject it (NOT_SUPPORTED); only the Layer-2 run tagged [FAULT:CONSENT_REVOKED] owned by WP-30 proves it.

registry.injectionPoint: consent-registry revocation during a call and while work is pending

postconditions: Recording and AI processing stop for the revoked dimension within the same turn
No notification is sent on a revoked subscription
The revocation and its effects are audited
